# clavis update

<p class="cli-lead">Check for a new release and show how to update</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis update
```

</div>

Check GitHub for a newer release and print the command that updates this
copy of Clavis. It works out how Clavis was installed (Homebrew, Scoop,
WinGet, Docker, Helm, a .deb, .rpm or .apk package, `go install`, the
install script, or a build from source) and shows the matching command.
It also shows the version of your server.

Interactive commands print a short note once every few days when an
update is waiting, or when the CLI and the server differ in minor
version. The check runs at most once a day, sends nothing about you, and
is skipped in CI. Set `CLAVIS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to turn it off.

## Examples

```sh
clavis update
```

<p class="cli-example-title">For scripts</p>

```sh
clavis update --json
```
